_comment: The screenshot set: how capture.mjs reaches each screen, and the headline and
sub line render.mjs prints over it. English only for now; add an "sv" key to
every title/sub/tagline (and "sv" to LANGS in render.mjs) to add a listing.
Copy rules (see store/README.md and the copywriting skill): the app is a drink
journal with alcohol-free streaks and an ESTIMATE. Never call it a breathalyzer,
a test, a measurement or a BAC calculator, never imply fitness to drive, never grade a number, no
exclamation marks, no em-dashes. Only claim what the app visibly does.
steps: { tab } clicks a bottom-nav tab by its label; { click } clicks the first
button whose text contains the string; { scrollTo } centers (and { scrollToTop }
scrolls to the top) the first element
whose own text contains the string; { wait } waits until the text is on the
page. 'page' names the capture file captures/<id>-<page>.png.
